SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. 1. File No.
Date... / ...
April 19, 1929

Chung Hua Steam Shipping Company.

Further to my report of April 18, I have obtained an
interview with Mr. Li Fu-tang (李復堂) who states that,
despite the fact that he has been badly let down by
Yang (楊振華) and Wang Ching-chuan, he has derived no financial gain. The money
put in by Li and the loan from the Bank were swallowed up
in extensive office alterations and the $1,000 which Yang
took as "personal expenses."

Li is confident that he can put the business on a sound
footing and informs me that he is negotiating with a
Dairen group, composed for the most part of ex-officials,
to put up capital for the purchase of ships. At the same
time he is negotiating with Mr. Wright of Messrs Hansons
for the acquisition of Jardine, Matheson & Co. shipping
interests. In support of the last statement, he showed me
a letter addressed to him by Messrs Hansons, copy of which
is as under (the copy was obtained without Li's knowledge
or consent).-

April 5, 1929.
Dear Sir,
We write to inform you that on receipt by
us of official notification from the Hongkong &
Shanghai Bank, Dairen, that they hold the sum of
Mex. 3 million for our account which sum has then to
be transferred to the Shanghai Branch of the Bank for
the same account we are prepared to carry on the
negotiations for the acquisition of certain British
shipping interests.
Yours faithfully,
(Sd.) Hansons.

Mr. F. T. Lee,
Manager,
Chung Hwa Shipping Company.

第 1 号。档案编号。

1929年4月19日

中华轮船公司。

继我4月18日的报告之后，我会见了李復堂先生，他表示，尽管他被杨（楊振華）和王晴川严重辜负，但他并未从中获得任何经济利益。李投入的资金以及从银行获得的贷款，都耗费在大规模的办公室装修以及杨作为“个人开支”拿走的1,000美元上。

李确信他能使业务走上正轨，并告知我他正在与一个主要由前官员组成的大连团体进行谈判，由该团体提供购买船舶的资本。同时，他正与汉森洋行（Messrs Hansons）的赖特先生谈判，以收购怡和洋行（Jardine, Matheson & Co.）的航运权益。为了佐证后一说法，他给我看了一封汉森洋行写给他的信，副本如下（该副本是在李不知情或未同意的情况下获得的）。-

1929年4月5日。
尊敬的先生：
兹致函告知，当我们收到汇丰银行大连分行发出的正式通知，称其代我方持有墨银300万元，且该款项随后需转入该行上海分行同一账户时，我们准备继续进行关于收购某些英国航运权益的谈判。
此致，
敬礼，
（签名）汉森洋行。

李福堂先生，
经理，
中华轮船公司。

April 19, 1929

Chung Hwa Steam Shipping Company.

Further to my report of April 18, I have obtained an interview with Mr. Li Fu-tang (李復堂) who states that, despite the fact that he has been badly let down by Yang Ching-hua (楊振華) and Wang Ching-chuan, he is determined to carry on and has no desire, for the time being at least, to bring them into Court. Li, according to his statement, is out some $5,000 so far. Wang and Yang put up no money whatsoever; in fact Yang pocketed $1,000 of the loan made by the Bank on the guarantee of Mr. Wen Shih-cheng. Wong, to Li's knowledge, derived no financial gain. The money put in by Li and the loan from the Bank were swallowed up in extensive office alterations and the $1,000 which Yang took as "personal expenses."

Li is confident that he can put the business on a sound footing and informs me that he is negotiating with a Dairen group, composed for the most part of ex-officials, to put up capital for the purchase of ships. At the same time he is negotiating with Mr. Wright of Messrs Hansons for the acquisition of Jardine, Matheson & Co. shipping interests. In support of the last statement, he showed me a letter addressed to him by Messrs Hansons, copy of which is as under (the copy was obtained without Li's knowledge or consent).-

April 5, 1929.

Dear Sir,
We write to inform you that on receipt by us of official notification from the Hongkong & Shanghai Bank, Dairen, that they hold the sum of Mex. 3 million for our account which sum has then to be transferred to the Shanghai Branch of the Bank for the same account we are prepared to carry on the negotiations for the acquisition of certain British shipping interests.
Yours faithfully,
(Sd.) Hansons.

Mr. F. T. Lee,
Manager,
Chung Hwa Shipping Company.

1929年4月19日

中华轮船公司。

继我4月18日的报告之后，我会见了李復堂先生，他表示，尽管他被杨振华（楊振華）和王晴川严重辜负，但他决心继续经营，且至少目前无意将他们告上法庭。据李陈述，他目前已损失约5,000美元。王和杨未投入任何资金；事实上，杨将温世珍先生担保从银行贷得的款项中的1,000美元装入私囊。据李所知，王未获得任何经济利益。李投入的资金以及从银行获得的贷款，都耗费在大规模的办公室装修以及杨作为“个人开支”拿走的1,000美元上。

李确信他能使业务走上正轨，并告知我他正在与一个主要由前官员组成的大连团体进行谈判，由该团体提供购买船舶的资本。同时，他正与汉森洋行（Messrs Hansons）的赖特先生谈判，以收购怡和洋行（Jardine, Matheson & Co.）的航运权益。为了佐证后一说法，他给我看了一封汉森洋行写给他的信，副本如下（该副本是在李不知情或未同意的情况下获得的）。-

1929年4月5日。

尊敬的先生：
兹致函告知，当我们收到汇丰银行大连分行发出的正式通知，称其代我方持有墨银300万元，且该款项随后需转入该行上海分行同一账户时，我们准备继续进行关于收购某些英国航运权益的谈判。
此致，
敬礼，
（签名）汉森洋行。

F. T. Lee 先生，
经理，
中华轮船公司。

2.

Whether or not Li succeeds in his venture scarcely
concerns this Department, but his statement that he
is after Jardine's ships, which is backed by the letter
from Hansons, is in itself interesting, and I am inclined
to think that Mr. Wen Shih-cheng has now taken a hand in
the matter, although remaining in the background, despite
the fact that Li was very anxious that I should understand
that Mr. Wen learned of the Dairen group from him only
yesterday morning. Li added that possibly Sun Chuan-fang
would be one of the group and that he would have fuller
particulars as to its membership within the next three or
four days.

The only point which is causing Li worry is how to
keep the deserters Wang and Yang from claiming any rights
in future as Wang has on one or two occasions signed as
Managing Director while Yang is the person who signed the
lease with Sassoon's people.

Tho Robertson
C. D. I.

A/D.C.I.

pages.zh:
2.

李是否能在其冒险事业中成功，与本部门关系不大，但他声称正在谋求获取怡和洋行的船只，且有汉森洋行的信件为证，这一说法本身颇有意思。我倾向于认为温世珍先生现已介入此事，尽管仍躲在幕后，尽管李非常希望让我明白，温先生直到昨天上午才从他那里得知大连团体的情况。李补充说，孙传芳可能是该团体成员之一，他将在未来三四天内获得关于该团体成员的更详细信息。

唯一令李担忧的是，如何防止逃兵王和杨在未来主张任何权利，因为王曾在一两次场合以总经理身份签字，而杨是与沙逊家族的人签署租赁合同的人。

Tho Robertson
刑事侦缉督察
助理刑事侦缉处长

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
File No. 107.
No. C. I. D.../O.7......
Date...18.4.29.....

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
April 18, 1929.

With reference to attached report on the Chung Hua Steam
Shipping Company, it appears that sometime in the Spring of
last year one Yang Chung-hua (楊振華), a former bodyguard
of the late Mr. Roy Anderson of Lincheng fame, approached
Mr. Wen Shih-cheng, Commissioner of Foreign Affairs for
Kiangsu in the Chi Shih-yun regime, with a story that he,
Yang, was in the employ of a multi-millionaire named
Wang Ching-yuan (王晴川), thought to be a Japanese subject
who was coming to Shanghai from Hongkong to establish a
shipping line on a big scale, and that he, Yang, would be
appointed Manager of the concern.

Nothing further was heard of the project until October
when Yang produced his millionaire master to Mr. Wen. In
his conversation with Mr. Wen, Wang spoke in millions and
said it was his intention to start with a fleet of at least
forty ships and a capital around $50,000,000. Against this
Mr. Wen contended that a modest $5,000,000 would be ample.
Wang agreed, but pointed out that as neither he nor Yang
had shipping experience it would be necessary to find a
suitable man to act as Sub-Manager to Yang. Accordingly,
Mr. Wen, introduced Mr. Li Fu-tang (李福堂) as a man of
integrity and one who had had good experience in the Customs
service. Li was formally appointed to the post and instruct-
-ed by Wang to find suitable offices. Li ultimately, in
December, informed Wang that there were offices to be had in the
Sassoon Building and at the same time brought up the
question of initial funds. Wang was promptly all apologies
and regrets that for the time being he had no credit in
Shanghai, and suggested that Li could, as a temporary
measure, raise this meagre amount from Mr. Wen or other
friends. The result was that Mr. Wen guaranteed a bank
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
档案编号 107。
刑事侦缉处编号.../O.7......
日期...18.4.29.....

(刑事侦缉处) 办公室笔记
1929年4月18日。

关于附呈的中华轮船公司报告，看来去年春季某个时候，杨振华（楊振華），已故以临城案闻名的罗伊·安德森先生的前保镖，接触了齐燮元政权下的江苏外交专员温世珍先生，编造故事称他杨受雇于一位名为王晴川（王晴川）的百万富翁，此人被认为是日本籍，将从香港来到上海大规模建立一条航运线，而他杨将被任命为该企业的经理。

此后直到十月，该项目再无音讯，当时杨将其百万富翁主人引荐给温先生。在与温先生的谈话中，王开口便是数百万，并表示打算以至少四十艘船的船队起步，资本约为5,000万美元。对此，温先生反驳说， modest 的500万美元就足够了。王表示同意，但指出由于他和杨都没有航运经验，有必要找一位合适的人担任杨的副经理。因此，温先生介绍了李福堂（李福堂），称其为正直之人，且在海关服务方面有良好经验。李被正式任命为该职，并受王指示寻找合适的办公场所。最终，李在十二月告知王，沙逊大厦有办公室可供租赁，同时提出了启动资金的问题。王随即连连道歉并表示遗憾，称他目前在上海没有信用，并建议李作为临时措施，可以向温先生或其他朋友筹集这笔微薄的资金。结果是温先生担保了一笔银行

pages.en:
File No.
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
2.
loan of $5,800. The fact that this big-talking millionaire
from Hongkong should be without credit in Shanghai
nevertheless raised Mr. Wen's suspicions that all was not
square, and he accordingly dropped a hint to Li to insert
an advertisement in the local Chinese press intimating the
commencement of the Chung Hua Line and that Mr. Wang Ching-
chuen, a wealthy overseas Chinese, held himself responsible
for the financing of it. The appearance of the notice in
the newspaper seemed to scare Wang who called on Mr. Wen
and informed him that publicity at this particular juncture
was most inadvisable. Exactly why it was inadvisable, was
not made clear to Mr. Wen.
Anyhow, Li went ahead with the securing of offices, and
a lease dating from February 1 was signed by Yang who, however
has since dropped into the background while his wealthy
employer has disappeared entirely. Deserted by the two
principals and realizing that he has been their dupe, Li,
to save his face, is struggling on and is negotiating with
a group of local Chinese business men for the purchase of
a small ship named the "Hua Heng" at present owned by the
Sin Hwa Steamshipping Company. He is not likely to succeed
however, and moreover I find, on enquiry at the New
Engineering Works where this vessel was recently docked,
that the hull is rotten and in fact the "Hua Heng" is only
fit for the shipbreakers as her repair is entirely out of
the question.
In an interview I had with Li, he was anything but frank,
apparently feeling sore over the whole matter, and held to
the mythical plans of Wang and Yang whose names, however, he
never mentioned. Both Wang and Yang at that time had not
come into the picture in my enquiries. Mr. Wen informed me
that Li is well known to him and entirely above suspicion.
It is known that Li, in his hopeless struggle to carry on,
pages.zh:
档案编号。
(刑事侦缉处) 办公室笔记
2.
贷款5,800美元。这位来自香港的夸夸其谈的百万富翁在上海竟然没有信用，这一事实引起了温先生的怀疑，觉得事情并不正当，因此他向李暗示，在当地中文报刊上刊登广告，透露中华航线的开业消息，并称富有的华侨王晴川先生对其融资负责。报纸上出现该通告似乎吓到了王，他拜访了温先生，并告知他在此特定时刻进行宣传是极不明智的。至于为何不明智，并未向温先生阐明。
无论如何，李继续着手落实办公室事宜，一份自2月1日起生效的租赁合同由杨签署，然而杨此后已退居幕后，而其富有的雇主则完全消失。被两位主要负责人抛弃，并意识到自己成了他们的傀儡，李为了保全面子，仍在苦苦支撑，并与一群当地中国商人谈判，购买一艘名为“华恒”号的小船，该船目前由新华轮船公司所有。然而，他不太可能成功，此外，我在询问最近停靠该船的新工程厂（New Engineering Works）后发现，船体已经腐烂，事实上，“华恒”号只适合送去拆船厂，因为修理它完全不可能。
在我与李的一次面谈中，他毫不坦率，显然对整个事件感到愤懑，并坚持王和杨那些神话般的计划，然而他从未提及他们的名字。当时在我的调查中，王和杨都尚未进入视野。温先生告诉我，李为他所熟知，且完全无可疑之处。众所周知，李在其无望的维持经营的努力中，

pages.en:
File No.
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
3.
has had great difficulty in raising money to pay the
office rent($500 per mensem) for March and April.
Whether persons other than Mr. Wen and Li have been
victimized it is impossible to state at the present moment,
but perhaps matters will be cleared up somewhat by a
further interview with Li when he will be told that as
the matter has shown itself to be of a criminal nature
it will be imperative that he make a full statement to
clear himself. As to Yang, he is said to be residing at
Ya Chou (亞州) Hotel, 255 Hankow Road and efforts will
be made to interrogate him.
The difficulty of a criminal prosecution in this case
lies in the fact that Mr. Wen considers that Li's
reputation might suffer in consequence and he would much
prefer to let his $5,800 go. Nevertheless he is thinking
of placing the matter in the hands of his lawyer.
Jno Robertson
C. D. I.
A/D.C.I.

(刑事侦缉处) 办公室笔记
3.
在筹集资金支付三月和四月的办公室租金（每月500美元）方面遇到了极大困难。
除温先生和李之外是否有其他人受害，目前无法断定，但也许通过与李的进一步面谈，事情会有所澄清，届时将告知他，鉴于此事已显示出犯罪性质，他必须做出完整陈述以洗清自己。至于杨，据说住在汉口路255号的亚洲（亞州）酒店，我们将努力对其进行讯问。
本案提起刑事诉讼的困难在于，温先生认为李的声誉可能会因此受损，他宁愿放弃那5,800美元。尽管如此，他正考虑将此案交给他的律师处理。
Jno Robertson
刑事侦缉督察
助理刑事侦缉处长

C.I.D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 107
Date MARCH. 18th. 1929.

Subject (in full) Chung Hwa Steam Navigation Co.

Made by C.D.I. Prince Forwarded by [签名] A.C. Pol.

Reference to the attached inquiries shew that the
Chung Hwa Steam Navigation Company (中華航業公司) a new
firm opened offices some ten days ago in the new Sassoon
Building, Nanking Road. The business will be fully established
within the next two weeks. It is stated that the capital of
the firm will be $50.000.000 in shares mostly taken up by rich
Chinese in Nanyang, Philipine Islands? It is also stated
that the firm will operate forty steamers between Shanghai and
Yangtse River Ports, also in foreign trade. The office
accommodation being taken up is extensive though not yet fully
established. H.B. Lee, the President of this company is
unknown to us and inquiries are being made regarding his
antecedents and further report will be forwarded in due course.

(批：Cor. 11)

Tel. 62712

A.C.P. Pol'.

Notice issued by the Chun Hwa Steam Navigation Co.

The Shun Pao published the following notice
on January 29, 1920;-

As our Company has just been organized, great
care has to be exercised in the employment of our
staff. Those taken on must pass the necessary
examinations and must possess adequate experience
and good conduct. As preparatory arrangements
are being made at present, we shall publish another
advertisement in the newspapers in the event of
the services of specialists being required.
Those who have sent in their applications or have
called, are requested to wait. Furthermore, all
matters concerning this Company will be under the
personal management of our promoters: Wang Zing
Chuen, 王晴川 Yang Tseng Hwa, 楊增華 Tang Pao Tah 唐寶泰
and Li Fu Tang 李復堂 only. It is learned that
of late certain bad characters have been making
use of the name of this Company to defraud the
public by offering positions upon payment of a
sum of money. This is regretted. Meantime
we are making exhaustive enquiries into this
matter and any person who is found committing
the offence mentioned above will be dealt with
severely in accordance with law. The public
are hereby requested to take notice of this.

The Shun Pao dated January 29, 1920, publishes
the following announcement by Yang Tseng Hwa:-

I am solely responsible for the preparatory
arrangements of the Chun Hwa Steam Navigation Co.
All receipts or payments of money must bear my
personal signature or chop, otherwise I shall
not be responsible for such transactions.
pages.zh:
中华轮船公司发布的通告

《申报》于1920年1月29日刊登了以下通告：

鉴于本公司刚刚组建，在聘用职员方面须格外谨慎。受聘人员必须通过必要的考试，并具备充分的经验和良好的品行。目前正在进行筹备工作，如需聘请专家，我们将另行在报纸上刊登广告。
凡已递交申请或前来接洽者，敬请等候。此外，所有与本公司有关的事务，仅由我们的发起人王晴川（Wang Zing Chuen）、楊增華（Yang Tseng Hwa）、唐寶泰（Tang Pao Tah）和李復堂（Li Fu Tang）亲自管理。据悉，近期有一些不法分子利用本公司的名义，以收取钱财提供职位的方式诈骗公众。对此我们深表遗憾。同时，我们正在对此事进行彻底调查，任何被发现犯有上述罪行的人，将依法严惩。特此公告，望公众知悉。

1920年1月29日的《申报》刊登了楊增華（Yang Tseng Hwa）的以下声明：

本人对中华轮船公司的筹备工作负全责。所有款项的收支必须带有本人的亲笔签名或印章，否则本人不对此类交易负责。
